description: Agent Reputation: submit the sources behind one reputation record or score: each source with its id, kind (self-reported, a platform record, a counterparty attestation, a third-party audit, an on-chain record, a payment receipt or other), its issuer, whether it is independent of the agent and its operator, whether a third party can check it, when it was produced or last confirmed and how the record shows it (as verified, as self-reported or unlabeled); each claim with the source ids it rests on, whether it is presented as current and how it is shown; and optionally the subject agent and headline score, how old a source may be and still carry a current claim (12 months when left out) and the moment to read it at. The signed report says source by source whether it is self-reported, independent, checkable and how old it is, and claim by claim what it rests on, and names self-reported history presented as verified, a single source behind every claim, current claims resting only on sources too old to support them and claims with no source, then sources shown as verified that nobody else can check, claims resting only on parties tied to the agent, undated sources and self-reported history shown with no label, with the fix for each. Quoted endorsements against their source text are wever_testimonial-evidence-check, one claim against supplied evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check and a one-call brief on a counterparty is wever_counterparty-brief. Verdict sourcing_weak, sourcing_gaps, sourcing_unverified or sourcing_sound. POST /api/reputation-source-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-reputation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-reputation/.

as_of.description: The moment to read the sources at.

claims.description: Each claim the record or score makes.

current.description: Presented as true now; read as current when left out.

sources.description: The source ids it rests on.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

max_age.description: How old a source may be and still support a current claim, such as 12 months; 12 months when left out.

sources.description: Each source behind the record or score.

dated.description: When it was produced or last confirmed.

independent.description: The issuer is independent of the agent and its operator.

presented_as.description: How the record shows it to the reader.

verifiable.description: A third party can check it, such as by a signature or a public record.

score.description: The headline score as shown, such as 4.8 of 5.

name: wever_reputation-source-check
title: Reputation source check
